2.3.7 Report.Code
The Report.Code element specifies the code definitions for custom functions to be used in an
expression within a Report.<3>
The Report.Code element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1).
Following is the parent element of the Report.Code element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.Code element.
 <xsd:element name="Code" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
